name: SETN Schema Builder
author: setnconsultants

sections.description:
SETN Schema Builder Free provides locally generated core schema, a conservative allowlist of organization/business types, durable entity identities, semantic Topics, explicit FAQ applicability, service-area privacy controls, and Schema Health. It can operate alone or use Compatible Mode with detected Yoast SEO, Rank Math SEO, All in One SEO, or SEOPress installations. In Compatible Mode, overlapping provider-owned core entities are deferred while independently valid supplemental entities may still be emitted, including supported FAQPage, Service, DefinedTerm, and DefinedTermSet output. SBP Schema Topics, relationships, Schema Health, and knowledge-layer features remain available where applicable. SETN Schema Builder is developed by SE TN Consultants.

Free creates the structured-knowledge foundation. Map foundational entity and Topic relationships, inspect the Entity and Relationship registries, and publish connected AI-ready structured data. Automatic related-content discovery, confidence scoring, Pin/Ignore curation, and prioritized relationship recommendations require a separately distributed Pro or Agency edition.

The WordPress.org edition contains no license client, private updater, or paid-feature implementation. Updates are delivered only by WordPress.org. Commercial SETN Schema Builder editions are distributed separately and may add licensed intelligence features and direct private updates.

The Free edition makes no external licensing or commercial service calls during normal operation.

The Updates & Resources screen uses WordPress.org for update checks. No license, registration, mailing-list signup, time limit, or usage quota is required. Optional news and commercial-edition links are normal links and do not automatically transmit the site domain, administrator email, configuration, or diagnostics.

Free includes a cacheable /llms.txt assembled from bounded public SBP Organization, Service, Topic, and eligible FAQ knowledge. The shared delivery layer maintains an ownership-verified physical fallback when SBP owns the endpoint, without registration or licensing. It never overwrites an unverified public file and does not crawl or publish arbitrary WordPress content.

Configured public organization and contact information may intentionally appear in frontend JSON-LD and /llms.txt. Deleting the Free package preserves customer settings, Topics, relationships, entity identities, FAQs, and content because the commercial licensing-only uninstall routine is excluded.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate SETN Schema Builder from WordPress.org.
  2. Open SETN Schema Builder > Settings and complete the Business Profile.
  3. Choose Standalone Mode when SBP should own JSON-LD, or Compatible Mode when a supported schema provider should own it.
  4. Configure Services and optional Schema Topics.
  5. Enable FAQPage only after selecting a page that visibly contains the configured questions and answers.
  6. Review Schema Health.
  7. Use Updates & Resources for WordPress.org update status, documentation, and optional news or upgrade links.

Network activation is not supported in v1. On Multisite, activate and configure SBP separately per site.
sections.faq:
Does this replace an SEO plugin?

It can own a complete core graph in Standalone Mode. In Compatible Mode, the detected provider owns overlapping core entities while SBP may emit independently valid supplemental FAQPage, Service, DefinedTerm, and DefinedTermSet entities without guessing provider identifiers.

How does FAQ schema work?

FAQPage output requires explicit enablement, a designated page, and visible matching question and answer text. A dedicated FAQ block or shortcode is planned for a later release; it is not included in v1.

Can I upgrade to a commercial edition without losing settings?

Yes. Install the commercial package as an update/replacement using the same canonical setn-schema-builder/ directory. Core settings, Topics, relationships, Service identities, and content remain in the WordPress database.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Corrects Service applicability, decoded schema titles, description fallback, address privacy controls, and neutral public Topic naming.
  • Adds a conservative allowlisted Organization/business type setting while preserving the legacy ProfessionalService default.
  • Connects supported supplemental Service and Topic entities through documented Yoast SEO and Rank Math graph filters without guessing provider IDs.
  • Preserves the shared Free foundation, package boundaries, hybrid /llms.txt delivery, and all saved customer data.

1.0.0-rc3

  • Standardizes the public company, product, attribution, slug, and text-domain naming for release.
  • Finalizes the WordPress.org readme, screenshot captions, Free update-list destination, and RC3 package metadata.
  • Adds a packaged admin-menu icon and keeps the absolute llms.txt filesystem path out of the normal Schema Health view.
  • Preserves RC2 licensing, update delivery, package separation, saved data, and hybrid /llms.txt delivery behavior.

1.0.0-rc2

  • Finalizes Free foundational relationships while reserving automatic discovery, scoring, recommendations, and Pin/Ignore curation for Pro and Agency.
  • Ensures the WordPress.org package contains the polished locked presentation but no operational paid discovery implementation.
  • Preserves Topics, registries, schema output, settings, and existing relationship data through package replacement.

1.0.0-rc1

  • Adds release-candidate packaging, WordPress compatibility, compliance, readme, and SHA-256 verification gates without adding product features.
  • Keeps the public Stable tag at the numeric 0.9.5 release until final 1.0.0 publication.

0.9.5-beta

  • Reports generic schema mode and exact detected SEO/schema provider separately.
  • Reports whether SETN Schema Builder or another provider owns /llms.txt and keeps SBP knowledge/schema features active when deferred.
  • Detects physical public llms.txt files before WordPress rewrites, attributes bounded All in One SEO and Yoast signatures, and reports unknown files conservatively without mutation.
  • Preserves the curated FAQ Q&A, complete Organization description, raw Markdown links, real newlines, and targeted cache behavior introduced in v0.9.4.

0.9.4-beta

  • Adds curated AI-readable /llms.txt, a shared read-only public knowledge layer, targeted per-site caching, and factual Schema Health visibility. llms-full.txt and public/write Abilities remain deferred.
  • Includes exact curated FAQ questions and answers after public-page eligibility verification, with clean Markdown and word-safe bounded text.
  • Preserves an existing provider’s /llms.txt rewrite and reports factual route ownership in Schema Health.

0.9.3-beta

  • Adds durable Service identities, authenticated commercial package checks, explicit Multisite policy, bounded frontend relationship behavior, expanded provider compatibility, and separate Free/commercial release artifacts.
